description: A leaderboard score entry stored in a player's repository.

main.description: Published in the player's PDS when recording a run for a `games.opengaming.leaderboard.definition`. Supports single-integer `score`, multi-component `components` (Points + Time + Accuracy + Lamps), open-union genre `details` (such as rhythm-game `#judgmentBreakdown`), chart/build `version` hashes, deterministic `replay` blobs for post-EoS server-free verification, and optional multi-issuer inline `signatures`.

leaderboard.description: AT-URI of the `games.opengaming.leaderboard.definition` record in the game publisher's repository.

definitionCid.description: Optional CID snapshot of the `leaderboard.definition` record when the score was set.

game.description: Optional AT-URI of the game definition (`games.atmosphere.define`).

player.description: DID of the player who achieved this score (must match the repository DID housing this record).

score.description: Headline integer score value (e.g. points, milliseconds, or `defaultComponent` value). Recommended on all records so generic gamercards can render rankings without custom component logic; optional when `components` is provided.

displayScore.description: Optional pre-formatted fallback display string (e.g. `42 pts`, `1:06.03`, `99.42% · FC`) for lightweight feed viewers.

components.description: Optional dictionary map of component values keyed by the component keys declared in `leaderboard.definition#components`. Forward-compatible with the proposed Lexicon `map` schema type with zero wire or attestation CID migration.

details.description: Optional open-union genre breakdown (e.g. `games.opengaming.defs#judgmentBreakdown` for rhythm games, or any custom `$type` lexicon object).

version.description: Optional hash or version tag of the chart, map, or game build this score was earned on (matched against `leaderboard.definition#rankedVersions`).

replay.description: Optional deterministic input log or ghost replay blob stored in the player's PDS, enabling asynchronous community Labeler or AppView verification even after official server End-of-Service (EoS).

tag.description: Optional short metadata tag attached to the run (e.g. `posts:30,likes:12`).

recordedAt.description: Timestamp when the score was achieved.

signatures.description: Optional inline CID-first cryptographic attestations (`games.opengaming.defs#inlineSignature`). Kept optional so games remain playable and PDS-writable after server EoS.
